shortIntro.title: How to Run Solo Leveling: ARISE Without Turning Your Phone Into Lava
shortIntro.para1: Solo Leveling: ARISE brings your favorite manhwa to life with flashy skill animations, high-quality character models, and intense dungeon fights. All this gorgeousness means your device needs to be ready for some serious action.
shortIntro.para2: Low-end phones can still survive at reduced graphics, but mid-range and flagship devices will let you blast bosses and explore dungeons at smooth 45–60 FPS, without sweating bullets—or overheating your phone.

intro: Here are the verified minimum and recommended specs your Android device should have to enjoy Solo Leveling: ARISE without lag, stutter, or random frame drops.

minimum.RAM: 3GB minimum (just enough for one epic hunter squad)
minimum.CPU: Snapdragon 660 / Helio G70 / Kirin 710 or equivalent
minimum.Storage: 5GB free minimum (don’t forget space for updates!)
minimum.Internet: Stable 4G/WiFi connection for online dungeons and co-op

recommended.Storage: 6–8GB free recommended for updates and high-quality assets
recommended.Internet: Low-ping 4G/5G or Wi-Fi for seamless boss fights

ios_intro: Apple hunters, your iPhone or iPad must meet these specs to enjoy Solo Leveling: ARISE at full speed without lag or frame drops.
fps_intro: FPS in Solo Leveling: ARISE is like a boss fight gauge—it fluctuates depending on your device’s chipset, graphics settings, and how flashy the skill animations get.

fps_list.fps: 35–50 FPS Stable (smooth enough for casual hunters)

faqIntroText: Here are the most frequently asked questions about Solo Leveling: ARISE performance, heating, and device compatibility:

faqList.question: Can Solo Leveling: ARISE run on 3GB RAM phones?
faqList.answer: Yes, but graphics will be toned down and some effects disabled. Think of it as playing in stealth mode.

faqList.question: Does the game support 60 FPS?
faqList.answer: Yes, but only mid-range and flagship devices maintain stable 60 FPS during heavy battles.

faqList.question: Why is the game heating my phone?
faqList.answer: High-quality visuals and skill effects are demanding. Lower shadows, reduce effects quality, and keep auto-brightness off to control temperature.
